scripts.prep: shx mkdir -p dist/playground/images && concat node_modules/material-design-lite/material.min.js node_modules/seedrandom/seedrandom.min.js > dist/playground/lib.js && shx cp dist/playground/lib.js dist/lib.js
scripts.build-css: concat node_modules/material-design-lite/material.min.css frontend/styles/style.css frontend/playground-master/styles.css > dist/playground/bundle.css && shx cp dist/playground/bundle.css dist/bundle.css
scripts.build-html: copyfiles -u 2 "frontend/pages/**/*.html" "frontend/pages/**/*.js" "frontend/pages/**/*.json" "frontend/pages/**/Image/*" dist && copyfiles -u 1 "frontend/styles/*.css" dist && copyfiles -u 1 "frontend/playground-master/src/exos/*.js" dist && copyfiles -u 1 "frontend/playground-master/src/core/*.js" dist && shx cp frontend/playground-master/OLD_index.html dist/playground/index.html && copyfiles -j "frontend/playground-master/images/*" dist/playground/images && shx cp -r frontend/assets dist/
scripts.build-js: shx mkdir -p dist/playground && npx esbuild frontend/playground-master/src/playground.js --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2018 --minify --outfile=dist/playground/bundle.js && shx cp dist/playground/bundle.js dist/bundle.js
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run prep && npm run build-js && npm run build-css && npm run build-html
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run serve
